articles.summary: On June 17, Pony.ai Founder and CEO James Peng joined MOVE London 2026 for a fireside chat titled “Scaling Autonomy: Becoming a Global Player.” The session took place on the Keynote Stage at ExCeL London and was moderated by Michael Dean, Global Head of Automotive Research at Bloomberg Intelligence.
